about: Text → the pieces a file is cut into for search, measured in tokens (filesystem.md, Indexing, by tokens): at most `size` tokens each (raised to 16 when smaller), the next one beginning at the start of the token `overlap` tokens (at most half the size) before the cut; the cut just after a paragraph break, else a line break, else a sentence's ". ", looked for in the window's last third (by characters), else at the end of the window's last token; CRLF read as LF, the text trimmed, every piece trimmed; pieces under 40 characters dropped; a text of at most `size` tokens is one piece. `tokenizer: words` is the stand-in for an embedder's: a token is a run of non-whitespace characters. LLeMbas: services/library/chunks.py (to be written); CLI: library/chunks.ts (to be written).
